notes.title: New Demo page - Live Now!
notes.content:
[h3]Ayo![/h3]

Steam recently updated how [b]demos[/b] can be displayed, giving more power and options to us, the developers. We won't cover all the details, but the important part is that there's now a [b][u]new page for the Eclipsium demo![/u][/b]

[h3]What will change?[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now [b][u]leave a review[/u][/b] on the demo!
[*] It's easier to manage the demo in your Steam library
[*]The demo page can appear in more places on Steam
[/list]
[h3]Why are you telling me this?[/h3]
Mostly because we would greatly appreciate each and every one of you [b][u]leaving a review[/u][/b] on the demo. We read and value all the feedback we receive, so the more the merrier. It also helps us grow and reach more people through Steam. 

[h3]Is the demo updated?[/h3]
Right now our number one priority is to work on the final version of the game rather than updating the demo. This means that all the content in the demo is the same as before (other than minor bug fixes).

If you still have any questions, don't hesitate to ask us.

[u]So what are you waiting for? Go play the demo if you haven't already, and please [b]leave us a review![/b][/u]

///[i]Housefire[/i]

notes.title: Eclipsium - Quick Devpost!
notes.content:
[h3]Ayo![/h3]
Last time we shared a devpost was a couple of months ago and a lot has happended since then so we thought we'd give you all a quick update.

[h3]- Development[/h3]
We've been hard at work planning, refining and creating content for the game. We're super excited about what we have in the works and we can't wait for you all to experience it.  Here's a quick sneak peak of one of the new areas we've added to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091159/7a8d74fd590dbf19f9f837d2dba8367260bd42ed.gif[/img]
[h3]- Graduation[/h3]
Last week Eclipsium graduated! Well, all developers working on the game did. Eclipsium originally started off as a student project which we then decided to keep working on during our studies. Having now graduated, we're happy to say that the entire team is committed to continue development full-time! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091159/04cc8df7166338651032c560ed6d95e6104ada5a.png[/img]
[h3]- Thank you[/h3]
Lastly we want to give a huuuuuge thank you to everyone who has supported the game up to this point and beyond. We wouldn't be here doing this if it wasn't for you and we couldn't be happier ːluvː

For more sneak peaks into the development of Eclipsium go follow us on Twitter and join our discord server!
